title: Both Pieces on One File
setup: Black has a bishop on e8 and a rook on e7, and every one of your heavy pieces is aimed at that same file.
hint: When two defenders stand on one line, only the front one can be taken. Ask what the second is really doing.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qxe8+}} forces {{Rxe8}} — the rook must leave the seventh — and {{Rxe8#}} is mate because the pawns have sealed the king in themselves. Stacking defenders on one file means losing them one after another.
